title: Deployment Guardrails: Quickstart walkthrough screens for progressive releases, version lock, and fallback policies
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a compact quickstart flow and asset pack that demonstrates Redwood Console's deployment guardrails for progressive releases: a lightweight progressive-release walkthrough (traffic split visualization), a version-lock (pin) modal/screens, and an emergency fallback policy screen. Assets will be used in product docs, the Console onboarding tour, and release announcement docs. Focus on clarity for first-time users and minimal cognitive overhead for engineers configuring rollouts.
assets: figma: Deployment Guardrails Quickstart (pages: Overview, ProgressiveFlow, VersionLockModal, FallbackPolicy) - v1.2
acceptance_criteria: Three primary flows covered: progressive rollout walkthrough, version pin/unpin modal, and fallback policy (auto and manual) screen
All screen designs exported in PNG and SVG at required dimensions and included in docs PR
Design copy reviewed and embedded into Console tour content by PM
Design review sign-off obtained from Eng lead (runtime) and PM
design_decisions: Prefer a compact stacked traffic-split bar with percentage chips instead of a full chart to reduce noise for first-time users
Use a single modal pattern for version pin to minimize navigation paths; advanced options are hidden behind an 'Advanced settings' toggle
Fallback policy UI defaults to 'auto-fallback to stable' to reduce accidental misconfiguration, but allows explicit manual override
